response.overview: Fūrin Kazan (2006) is a single-episode Japanese historical drama special aired on TV Asahi on January 8, 2006, running about 2 hours and 2 minutes. It is adapted from Yasushi Inoue's historical novel of the same name (The Samurai Banner of Furin Kazan), which draws its title from Takeda Shingen's battle banner inspired by Sun Tzu's The Art of War ("Swift as the Wind, Silent as a Forest, Fierce as Fire and Immovable as a Mountain").
response.title: Furin Kazan
